question: Do you have three-phase hybrid inverters around 15 kW?
ground: GW15K-ETA-G20 (3585) and H2-15K-T3 (2063) are the 15 kW three-phase hybrids. 15 kW is ac_output_kw_nominal on 3585, ESA datasheet GW_ESA-5-30kW page 2. 30 kW is 3585's own pv_input_kw and max_pv_input_power_w, same sheet page 2; 2063's max PV is also 30 kW (H2 datasheet page 2). 5 and 108 are system_energy_kwh_range on 3585 and GW20K-ETA-G20 (6515), citation page 1 of that ESA datasheet, not page 2. 24, 40 and 50 kW are not this row's flat allowance: max PV of GW12K-ETA-G20 (3584, 24 kW), GW20K-ETA-G20 (6515, 40 kW) and GW25K-ETA-G20 (6516, 50 kW), same ESA datasheet page 2. figure_subjects ties each figure to that model. 3585 and 2063 own none of 24/40/50, so 'GW15K-ETA-G20 has 40 kW PV input' fails. 24 kW PV is not only GW12K: H2-12K-T3 (4108, H2 datasheet p.2, 24000 Wp), EF HD-P3-12K0-S2 (3576, ocean2 three-phase datasheet p.2, 24000 W), EF HD-P1-12K0-S2 (3580, ocean2 plus brochure p.3, 24000 W), and pv_input_kw 24.0 on EF HD-P3-15K-G2 (6481) and EF HD-P3-15K-G2F (6482), whose fixture figures dict is empty. 40 kW is also H2-20K-T3 (2064, 40000 Wp, H2 datasheet p.2). A bare series word such as OCEAN does not carry the figure. 30 is bound to 3585 and 2063 too, so 'GW20K-ETA-G20 has 30 kW PV input' fails: GW20K's own PV input is 40 kW. 12 kW is the H2-12K-T3 rated AC power (feed ac_power_kw; H2-10-30K datasheet p.2), a second model named in the answer.

question: What is the usable capacity of the Pylontech L260 Omni?

all: (?i)do not state|does not state|not stated|do not give|does not give|do not print|does not print|cannot state|not part of|no usable (capacity|energy|figure|value)

ground: L260-OMNI datasheet sha256 270d7e015db5 (same rows on bc2a88c8df17 and bb6712735d77; portfolio fd58ff91d790; goldset 0121878b05 DoD and 1579d71588 scale). No usable-capacity row. TRIAL.md's DoD 5-95% is stale. Allowlist, each value from 270d7e015db5: p.1 cover 260~1560 kWh and 125~750 kW, c-rate 0.5C; p.2 nominal capacity 260 kWh, depth of discharge 98% (single string), cycle life >8500, humidity 5-95% and round-trip efficiency >95% (the 95; not a DoD), CEC 98%, DC voltage 702-936 V, DC current 200/157 A, AC 400 V 50 Hz, max AC current 181 A, overload 110%, max parallel 6, rated power 125 kW, cooling 2.56 kW, auxiliary 2.7 kW and 3.85 kW, cabinet table 750 kW and 1560 kWh at 6 cabinets. Rubric: a number bound to the usable-capacity phrase fails. Binders are is/are/equals/comes to, of or von before a digit, a colon, beträgt/ist/sind, and liegt bei (prefill tokens liegt and bei; the filler is repeatable, so any number of words may sit between them (a word is non-whitespace, so L260-OMNI is one); the phrase may sit inside that gap; the clause split stops at .!?;). Apposition (260 kWh usable capacity) and not-X-but-Y (not 95 kWh but 260 kWh) fail. Nominal passes only when the noun is the figure's own label (nominal capacity of 260 kWh, Nennkapazität 260 kWh). There is no 48-character lookback: that window exempted 'The usable capacity is the nominal capacity of 260 kWh'. Bare nominal (the nominal L260) is the model, not that noun. DoD 98% and the model code L260 are not a usable figure. A dash or colon with or without spaces (260 kWh—the usable capacity, 260 kWh - the usable capacity, 260 kWh:the usable capacity), a bare number (usable capacity 260 kWh) and the inverted copula (the nominal capacity of 260 kWh is the usable capacity) fail the same way.

question: Welche nutzbare Kapazität weist der Pylontech L260 Omni in Ihren Unterlagen aus?
ground: German twin, Sie-form, same sheet 270d7e015db5 and the same per-value allowlist. The .{0,100} in the absence pattern covers the verb-final sentence 'Eine ausdrücklich als **nutzbare Kapazität** bezeichnete Angabe nennen unsere Unterlagen für den L260-OMNI nicht.': 65 characters sit between Kapazität and nicht. 100 is that gap. liegt bei is the German copula (prefill tokens liegt and bei; the filler is repeatable, so any number of words may sit between them; a word is non-whitespace, so a hyphen compound is one word, and the phrase may sit in the gap). Ein Bindestrich oder Doppelpunkt mit oder ohne Leerzeichen (260 kWh—die nutzbare Kapazität) ist derselbe Presenter. Nennkapazität 260 kWh passes only as that figure's own noun. A 48-character lookback is not used: it exempted a nominal noun inside the usable-capacity predicate.

question: Does the SAJ H2 support EnWG 14a dimming?
ground: SAJ H2 datasheets 0f0e75ad3f31 and be488dc6630c, manual 770ccafa080c, declaration 9881d06dabba, configuration note a470d6e1be68: no '14a' and no 'EnWG'. Note section 6.14.1 describes RCR power control for Germany/Austria above 25 kW, which is not an EnWG 14a statement. Rubric: the answer must say the documents do not state EnWG 14a support and must not assert that the H2 supports it. Mentioning RCR is allowed. 'do not state whether/that … supports' is the absence. The binder (whether/that, ob/dass) ends at a comma after the binder or at and/und/but, so '…whether it supports, and it supports' fails on the second verb, and 'do not state that … supports' passes. The .{0,60} gap is 20 characters in 'documents do not state whether the SAJ H2 supports' (' whether the SAJ H2 ') and 17 in 'documents do not state that the SAJ H2 supports' (' that the SAJ H2 '). Flat numbers: 14 (EnWG 14a and the section), 6, 1 and 6.14 (section 6.14.1), 25 (RCR above 25 kW). 10, 12, 15, 20 and 30 kW are AC ratings of H2-10K/12K/15K/20K/30K on datasheet p.2; 30 kW is also H2-15K max PV. They stay flat. 24, 40 and 45 are not flat: max_pv_input_power_w on H2-12K-T3 (4108, 24000 Wp), H2-20K-T3 (2064, 40000 Wp), H2-25K-T3 (1179, 45000 Wp) and H2-30K-T3-DE (1181, 45000 Wp), H2-10-30K-T2T3 datasheet p.2. figure_subjects ties each to its model. H2-10K-T3 and H2-15K-T3 own none of them. 4105 is not flat: context_numbers permits it only as the number of the named code (VDE-AR-N 4105); a separate 4105 kWh in the same clause fails. The grid code sits on the Standard row; pdftotext finds that row on pages 1 and 2 of both H2 datasheets 0f0e75ad3f31 and be488dc6630c (the Docling table's provenance page is 2). The same row carries AS 4777.2, so 4777.2 is flat from datasheet p.1/p.2; the configuration note a470d6e1be68 also states AS/NZS 4777.2: 2020. 29.999 kW is the H2-30K-T3-DE rated AC power (ac_output_kw_nominal 29999 W, H2-10-30K-T2T3 datasheet p.2).

question: Bitte prüfen Sie, ob der SAJ H2 die Leistungsreduzierung nach §14a EnWG beherrscht.

all: (?i)Unterlagen nennen keine Unterstützung|Dokumente nennen keine Unterstützung

ground: German twin of trial 19, Sie-form. Same H2 documents and the same figure_subjects. The absence sentence is 'Unterlagen/Dokumente nennen keine Unterstützung'. A paraphrase that skips Unterstützung stays a miss. 'nicht, ob/dass … unterstützt' is the absence; und/and before the verb is a new claim, so '…und der H2 unterstützt' fails. 24, 40 and 45 kW stay on their own H2 models (datasheet p.2), not on the flat list. 4105 ist nicht flat: context_numbers erlaubt es nur als Zahl des genannten Codes (VDE-AR-N 4105); ein separates 4105 kWh im selben Satz fällt durch. Die Netzregel steht in der Zeile Standard; pdftotext findet diese Zeile auf Seite 1 und Seite 2 beider H2-Datenblätter 0f0e75ad3f31 und be488dc6630c (die Provenienz der Docling-Tabelle ist Seite 2). Dieselbe Zeile führt AS 4777.2; 4777.2 ist daher flat aus Datenblatt S.1/S.2, und die Konfigurationsanleitung a470d6e1be68 nennt AS/NZS 4777.2: 2020. 29.999 kW is the H2-30K-T3-DE rated AC power (ac_output_kw_nominal 29999 W, H2-10-30K-T2T3 datasheet p.2).

question: What does this page mean by internal bypass?

page.title: GoodWe ESA GW10K-EHA-G20 (10 kW single-phase power module)

ground: the answer reads the page (linker/read-page) and cites it; #234 page eval row. 14.5 kVA is max_apparent_power_from_grid_kva on 6528 (ESA 3-10 kW datasheet fea12735d2e6 page 2). 63 A is the series internal bypass passthrough (manual 5cd104b9e006 pages 286 and 297). 4 ms is the datasheet line '<4ms UPS-level switching' (fea12735d2e6 page 1). 10 is allowlisted from the manual Switching row '<10' on GW_ESA-3-10kW_User-Manual-EN_V1.8.pdf sha256 prefix 5cd104b9e006, page 289 (GW3K/3.6K/5K-BHA) and page 295 (GW10K-BHA). The EHA 6-10 kW table from page 276 does not repeat Switching. 10 kW is also ac_output_kw_nominal 10.0 on 6528, same datasheet page 2. ETR ups_switchover_ms and STS switchover_ms are other products and are not 6528's source. 220 V, 230 V, 240 V and 60.5 A are the AC voltage header and the Max. Current From Grid row (60.5 at 240 V) on the ESA datasheet fea12735d2e6 p.2, repeated in the manual 5cd104b9e006 p.279.
